fact: Under `set -euo pipefail` a bare assignment `x="$(f)"` aborts the whole script when f returns non-zero; the errexit exemption only applies inside if/while/&&/||. A library function that gained a `return 1` crashed every blind-audit run whose allowlist override refused all lanes (P2-36).
recommendation: When a sourced function can return non-zero, capture it at the call site: `x="$(f)" || x=""` (or branch on rc), and add a caller test under set -e.

fact: bash reads a script incrementally, so editing scripts/adversarial-review.sh while any process runs it corrupts that run; review runs that use the driver on its own diff must use a frozen copy.
recommendation: Run reviews of the driver from a git-show snapshot (chmod +x) and make all driver edits in one go before running suites that execute it.

fact: A test that "cleans up" a shared machine-wide file (~/.zuvo/adversarial.log) by trimming to a pre-run line count deletes concurrent writers' rows, and a failed count read as 0 empties the file (GNU head -n 0).
recommendation: Never rewrite shared state in tests; count rows read-only and leave them, or sandbox the path via ZUVO_HOME.
